arguments.body: Hi Luca, your annual gas safety check is due before 16 October. This is written notice that a Gas Safe engineer from HeatRight Ltd plans to visit on Wednesday 14 October, 9am-12pm. Please be home or tell us if someone else can let them in. If that time doesn't suit, reply or call us with another time before 16 Oct and we'll rearrange; we won't enter without your agreement. Doing the check now keeps the same yearly renewal date, and you'll get a copy of the record within 28 days. We'll also send this by text and letter.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety? Which record do you trust and why?
answers.answer: Yes, currently compliant: the CP12 issued 2025-10-17 expires 2026-10-16 (Gas Safe 550123, matching HeatRight). I trust the compliance record (structured, dated, with file) over the legacy note 'renewed 2025, all good', which is vague hearsay and gives no dates. Compliance lapses after 16 Oct if not renewed.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Prior email and SMS got no reply, so I booked HeatRight for Wed 14 Oct 9-12 (more than 24h away, before expiry) and gave written notice by email, SMS and letter explaining how to rearrange. No entry without the tenant's agreement. Follow-up 13 Oct; further contact and escalation if still silent.
